description: FDA recalls batch (up to 10 terms) — Screen up to 10 products or ingredients against US FDA enforcement recalls in one call (openFDA, public domain). Pass ?q= terms separated by semicolons, optional ?type=drug (default) | food | device and ?limit=1-10 recalls per term (default 3). Returns per-term recall count, Class I count, newest date and top recalls, plus a CLASS I RECALLS FOUND / RECALLS FOUND / NO RECALLS FOUND verdict. Price: $0.02 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: fda_recalls_batch
